description: Continuous Distribution & Content Operating System for Rank Kiwi Website and Growth Flywheel.

principles.websiteIsSourceOfTruth: The website is the canonical home for substantial information, methodologies, datasets, and conversions. External channels are distribution engines, not endpoints.
principles.everyAssetHasAJob: No content is published merely to sustain a posting cadence. Assets must acquire search traffic, establish topical authority, explain product capabilities, or drive qualified discovery.
principles.nativeContentFirst: Every platform post provides immediate standalone value. Never use lazy link drops like 'New post published, click here'.
principles.traceableClaims: Every statistic, dataset, and factual finding must trace directly to a verified source, methodology, or aggregated data drop. No fabricated claims or vanity fluff.
principles.audienceOverVanity: Prioritize qualified engagement and downstream product intent over raw impressions or meaningless follower counts.

stages.name: Product & Research Insight
stages.description: Identify counterintuitive patterns, creator benchmarks, or workflow gaps from product telemetry, research datasets, or user questions.

stages.name: Flagship Website Asset
stages.description: Publish definitive research article, methodology guide, comparison shootout, or documentation walkthrough on rankkiwi.com.

stages.name: Atomized Distribution
stages.description: Repurpose core findings into native LinkedIn insights, X threads, Instagram carousels, YouTube breakdowns, and newsletter sections.

stages.name: Community & Earned Discovery
stages.description: Engage in relevant discussions, earn backlinks, and answer creator/marketer queries with evidence-backed methodology.

stages.name: Qualified Website Visit
stages.description: Visitors land on intent-matched, high-context pages (e.g. /outlier-score/, /research/*, /compare/*).

stages.name: Product Conversion & Activation
stages.description: Visitor installs free Chrome extension and runs first in-browser creator analysis.

stages.name: Feedback & New Insights
stages.description: User questions, search console patterns, and new platform updates fuel the next generation of content.

contentPillars.name: Outlier Content & Benchmarking Methodology
contentPillars.description: Why raw view counts mislead, why creator-relative medians matter, and how to identify breakout anomaly posts.

contentPillars.description: Channel median view baselines, Shorts vs long-form dynamics, high-resolution thumbnail extraction, and catalog audits.

contentPillars.name: Creator & Marketer Workflow Education
contentPillars.description: Actionable workflows for turning research into content hooks, spreadsheet databases, and editorial calendars.

contentPillars.name: Rank Kiwi Product Education & Walkthroughs
contentPillars.description: Step-by-step demonstrations showing how Rank Kiwi replaces friction-heavy manual research with 10-second in-browser sorting.

contentPillars.name: Original Research & Data Studies
contentPillars.description: First-party empirical studies, public dataset analyses (e.g. vidIQ 448k channels, Kaggle 10k Reels), and statistical benchmarks.

contentPillars.name: Building Rank Kiwi (Transparent Engineering)

level1_flagship.definition: High-effort, definitive assets published canonically on the website.

level2_supporting.definition: Structured educational or tactical assets expanding specific aspects of flagship assets.

level3_distribution.definition: Native, atomized derivative assets published on distributed social and community channels.

level4_conversation.definition: Lightweight, direct audience interactions and answers in public forums.

website_seo.role: Primary owned home, long-term organic search discovery engine, and conversion center.
website_seo.guidelines: Maintain pristine technical SEO, semantic HTML, structured data, and zero intrusive popups.

linkedin.role: Professional discovery and distribution for creator economy insights, research charts, and agency workflows.
linkedin.nativeFormat: Punchy hypothesis -> Data proof point -> Visual chart/card -> Actionable implication -> Contextual link in bio or comments.

x_twitter.role: Fast-paced research observations, breakdown threads, product update notes, and creator discussions.
x_twitter.nativeFormat: Provocative data hook -> 3-5 tweet analytical breakdown with chart -> Link to full methodology.

instagram.role: Visual proof and education for Instagram creators, Reels strategists, and short-form video editors.
instagram.nativeFormat: Multi-slide visual carousels breaking down real creator case studies and 30-second workflow Reels.

youtube.role: Deep-dive tutorials, research study breakdowns, tool comparisons, and workflow demonstrations.
youtube.nativeFormat: 1-3 minute focused tutorials and 15-45 second YouTube Shorts demonstrating outlier discovery.

newsletter.role: Direct-to-inbox research digest and weekly data drops for active creators, marketers, and power users.
newsletter.nativeFormat: 1 Surprising finding -> Why it matters -> Practical workflow -> Rank Kiwi tip -> Canonical link.

communities_reddit.role: Authentic participation, methodology clarification, and helpful answers in relevant creator subreddits.
communities_reddit.antiPatterns: Zero unsolicited link dropping, zero astroturfing, zero fake accounts. Disclose Rank Kiwi creator identity when relevant.

franchises.name: Rank Kiwi Research

franchises.name: Outlier Breakdown

franchises.name: Tool Breakdown
franchises.format: Honest, objective comparison of when to use Rank Kiwi vs legacy enterprise platforms or platform-native analytics.
